{{Wireless adapter |brand=BroMax |model=MW251 |revision= |upc= |ean= |asin= |price= |est_release_date= |fcc_date=09/10/2001 |manuf_country=Taiwan |manuf= |manuf_model= |manuf_rev= |if=PCI |vendor_id= |device_id= |subvendor_id= |subdevice_id= |fcc_id=O6M-MW251 |ic_id= |chip1_brand=Intersil |chip1_model=ISL3874 |chip2_brand=Intersil |chip2_model=ISL3685 |chip3_brand= |chip3_model= |flags= |ant_conn=RP-SMA |802dot11_protocols=b |txchains= |rxchains= |sstreams= |oui= |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} This device is a Mini PCI wireless module on a Mini PCI -> PCI adapter.
"ISL37400M SN REV C" is silkscreened on the Mini PCI wireless module. This device is clearly based on the [http://www.datasheetcatalog.org/datasheets/700/261518_DS.pdf Intersil ISL37400M reference design].
